snippet_primary: "1. Be a seller in a country with a cross-border minimum > $10 (e.g. Argentina, Colombia, South Korea, Paraguay) 2. Visit Settings → Payments 3. Change any field (e.g. update bank account) and save 4. The country's exchange-rate-dependent minimum is now persisted as your payout_threshold_cents 5. If the exchange rate drops, your threshold stays at the old higher value"
subject_exact: GitHub issue (github.com/antiwork/gumroad/issues/3837, Feb 27, 2026) reports a bug where sellers in countries with cross-border payout minimums above $10 (e.g., Argentina, Colombia, South Korea, Paraguay) have their exchange-rate-dependent payout threshold incorrectly persisted after updating payment settings; if the exchange rate drops the threshold remains at the older higher value
metric_value_raw: cross-border payout minimum >$10 for Argentina, Colombia, South Korea, Paraguay
local_qualifiers: GitHub issue (Feb 27, 2026): Gumroad bug — payout threshold persists at higher value for countries with minimums >$10 (Argentina, Colombia, South Korea, Paraguay); threshold does not decrease when exchange rate drops
